u0: The switch has not been flipped yet, so the exit is not yet a valid completion target. Go to the switch panel on the lower left wall, face it, and toggle it; a toggle of a silent switch still counts. Toggling the switch earns +0.1 and advances to u1. Do not step onto the exit before this, because reaching it without a prior switch toggle cannot complete the task.
u1: The switch has already been flipped and the exit requirement is satisfied. Head to the green exit in the bottom-right corner and step onto it. Reaching the exit earns +1 and advances to terminal state u2. Further switch toggles are unnecessary and leave this state unchanged; any box or siren events may occur but are not conditions of this reward machine.
u2: Terminal success: the switch was flipped and the agent has reached the exit. The task is complete; no further objective remains and no additional action can improve the outcome.
